description.value: Brokers exchange between the hearths and the hauling lodges, which is a standing position in practice and no position at all in anybody's account of how the band works. He lent a shear plate to the 2293 expedition and has asked for its return at every expedition since, and has been told each time that it is in a collection on Ceres and that a request has been filed. He now asks as a formality, at the start of each meeting, before anything else is discussed.

formOfAddress: by name with the hearth name after it

notes.value: The plate is catalogued on Ceres as an unprovenanced shearing tool. The 2293 expedition's field notes record it as borrowed, on a page nobody consulted until 2308.
